recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C)
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough
Add torn mozzarella pieces
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden
Top with fresh basil leaves and drizzle with olive oil

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the tikka masala paste for 30 minutes
Sauté onions and garlic until soft
Add remaining tikka masala paste and garam masala
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes
Add marinated chicken and cook until done
Stir in coconut cream and simmer for 10 more minutes
Garnish with fresh cilantro

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Wash and chop romaine lettuce
Toss lettuce with Caesar dressing
Add croutons and parmesan cheese
Top with anchovies if desired
Season with black pepper

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)
Mix flour and baking soda in a bowl
Cream together butter and both sugars
Beat in eggs and vanilla
Gradually blend in flour mixture
Stir in chocolate chips
Drop spoonfuls onto baking sheet
Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden brown

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet
Drain excess fat
Add taco seasoning and water as directed on packet
Simmer for 5-10 minutes
Warm taco shells in oven
Fill shells with beef mixture
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream, and salsa

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet
Add garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds
Add carrots and broccoli, stir-fry for 3 minutes
Add bell peppers and snap peas
Stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes
Add soy sauce and toss to combine
Serve over cooked rice

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat
Add onions and cook slowly for 40-45 minutes until caramelized
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add wine and deglaze the pan
Add beef broth, bay leaf, and thyme
Simmer for 30 minutes
Toast bread slices
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls
Top with bread and cheese
Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly

recipes.name: Greek Salad
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and bell pepper in a bowl
Add feta cheese and olives
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper
Drizzle dressing over salad
Toss gently to combine

recipes.name: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C)
Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan
Mix butter into mashed bananas
Mix in sugar, egg, and vanilla
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over mixture
Add flour and mix until just combined
Pour into prepared pan
Bake for 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package directions
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta until crispy
Add garlic to pancetta and cook for 1 minute
Beat egg yolks with Parmesan and black pepper
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain pasta
Remove pancetta pan from heat
Add hot pasta to pancetta and toss
Add egg mixture and toss quickly, adding pasta water to create creamy sauce
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan

recipes.name: Blueberry Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a bowl
Make a well in center and pour in milk, egg, and melted butter
Mix until smooth
Gently fold in blueberries
Heat a griddle or pan over medium heat
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake
Cook until bubbles form, then flip
Cook until golden brown on both sides
Serve with maple syrup

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil
Add lemongrass, lime leaves, and chilies
Simmer for 10 minutes
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes
Add shrimp and cook until pink
Stir in fish sauce, lime juice, and chili paste
Remove from heat
Garnish with cilantro and serve hot

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork
instructions: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and salt
Rub spice mixture all over pork shoulder
Place pork in slow cooker
Cook on low for 8 hours until meat falls apart
Remove pork and shred with two forks
Mix shredded pork with BBQ sauce
Serve on buns with coleslaw

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternating on a platter
Tuck basil leaves between slices
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar
Season with salt and pepper
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions
Season beef with salt and pepper
Brown beef in butter, then set aside
Sauté onions and mushrooms until soft
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir
Add beef broth and bring to simmer
Return beef to pan
Stir in sour cream and mustard
Heat through but don't boil
Serve over egg noodles
Garnish with parsley

recipes.name: Guacamole
instructions: Cut avocados in half and remove pits
Scoop avocado flesh into a bowl
Mash avocados with a fork
Add lime juice and salt
Mix in onion, tomatoes, cilantro, jalapeño, and garlic
Taste and adjust seasoning
Serve immediately with tortilla chips

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil
Add chicken breast and simmer for 20 minutes
Remove chicken, shred, and set aside
Add carrots, celery, onion, and garlic to broth
Add bay leaves and thyme
Simmer for 15 minutes
Add egg noodles and cook according to package directions
Return shredded chicken to pot
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh parsley

recipes.name: Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk egg yolks and sugar until thick and pale
Fold in mascarpone until smooth
Combine espresso and coffee liqueur in a shallow dish
Quickly dip ladyfingers in espresso mixture
Arrange a layer of soaked ladyfingers in a dish
Spread half the mascarpone mixture over ladyfingers
Repeat with another layer
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
Before serving, dust with cocoa powder
Top with chocolate shavings if desired

recipes.name: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes, then drain
Mix fish sauce, tamarind paste, and sugar for sauce
Heat oil in wok over high heat
Cook shrimp or chicken until done, set aside
Push ingredients to side and scramble eggs
Add noodles and sauce, toss to combine
Add bean sprouts and green onions
Return protein to wok and toss
Serve topped with crushed peanuts, lime wedges, and cilantro

recipes.name: Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C)
Mix apples, sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and lemon juice
Line pie dish with one crust
Pour apple mixture into crust
Dot with butter
Cover with second crust and seal edges
Cut slits in top crust
Brush with beaten egg
Bake for 15 minutes at 425°F
Reduce heat to 350°F (175°C) and bake for 35-40 minutes more
Cool before serving
